subject: TGP2 TLS/WLS compiler implemented (source 19f5e3f8); D8F18-30 H/V both branches 16/16 compile with proposed header; awaiting compute header + DEVICE WINDOW END for L2
body:
Source gpu/metal/tegu/mali_compute_compiler.c 19f5e3f8 (gated #ifdef TEGU_PIPELINE2_WORD_TLS; with current header 51cf599d behaviour = refusal, so the shared lib stays 57db4be4 until rebuild). Workgroup vars lowered exactly like pinned panvk_lower_nir (explicit types + 32bit_offset IO + optional zero-init); scratch limit 0x7000 (spill headroom under Valhall 16-bit TLS immediate), post-codegen tls<0x8000, wls<=32KiB, header w17=tls bytes/thread, w18=wls bytes/workgroup.
Private test libs (NOT production, persisted): gpu/build/lowering-claude-20261025/lib-wls-on (8e349343, built with proposed header proposed-header/pipeline_format.h ff2889fc) and lib-wls-off (161a6d76, current header). New test check_compute_v2_memory.py c1f1431b: on 10/10, off 10/10 (shared+barrier wls256, shared atomic wls4, shared float32 atomic CAS wls4, vec3 struct layout, private uint[16] tls64 with STORE/LOAD .tl, >32KiB shared refused, 36KiB private refused, D8F18H linear0/1, f7a70d refused). ISA shows STORE/LOAD .wls, BARRIER, .tl tls_ptr. compute-v2 113/113 and TGP1 boundary 65/65 in both modes (oracle check_compute_v2_compiler.py 7432e167 now allows w17/w18 and records tls/wls).
SpringBoard spot replay (bridge 8861e0a0, gpu/build/lowering-claude-20261025/d8f-spot/wls-on): D8F18H/V,22H/V,26H/V,30H/V linear0 all compile (no memory); linear1 all compile with TLS 32/16/64/64/96/96/192/192 bytes per thread, WLS 0. So the observed blocker is private memory (TLS), not threadgroup memory. With the current header (wls-off) linear1 refuses as before.
